Field.name: InputFile
Field.usage: Input image file to bin down in 3D

Field.name: SlicesMinAndMax
Field.usage: Starting and ending slices to analyze in Z (numbered from 1)
Field.manpage: Starting and ending slices to analyze in Z, numbered from 1. The default is to do all slices.

Field.name: XMinAndMax
Field.usage: Starting and ending coordinates to analyze in X
Field.manpage: Starting and ending coordinates to analyze in X, numbered from 0. The default is to omit borders equal to 10% of the X dimension.

Field.name: YMinAndMax
Field.usage: Starting and ending coordinates to analyze in Y
Field.manpage: Starting and ending coordinates to analyze in Y, numbered from 0. The default is to omit borders equal to 10% of the Y dimension.

Field.name: FlipYandZ
Field.usage: Treat coordinates as coming from volume flipped in 3dmod
Field.manpage: Treat coordinates as coming from a volume that was read into 3dmod with Y and Z sizes flipped with the -Y option. Thus, for a newly created tomogram loaded into 3dmod flipped, you can use this option to enter X, Y, and Z coordinates read out from 3dmod. The program assumes that flipping occurred by rotating around the X axis, unless the "-old" option is given.

Field.name: OldFlipping
Field.usage: Flipping was done with swapping of X and Y axes, not rotation around X.
Field.manpage: Flipped coordinates are based on flipping by swapping X and Y axes, not by rotating around X. This flipping occurred prior to IMOD 4.6.18.

Field.name: TruncateBlackAndWhite
Field.usage: Number of pixels to truncate as black and white
Field.manpage: Number of pixels to truncate as black and white in the analyzed volume. The default is one pixel per slice or one pixel per million, whichever is greater.
